why: Garbled ending 'gaza 3alaghan'; 'bucra' not Egyptian spelling; trails off unfinished.
'3al feddan el maw3ad' is meaningless; no Egyptian would type this.
'el share3 yeb2a feddan 3arabiyat' is an unnatural invented metaphor.
'atfada f2dan el ma7faza' is stilted MSA calque; Egyptians say 'ma adaya3sh'.
'el f2dan beta3ak', 'gham2a', 'naroo7 el narda' are garbled, unnatural.
'el f2dan beta3 el wa2t' calques 'loss of time'; Egyptian says tadyee3 el wa2t.
'fee mazad 3ala tool el shari3' makes no sense in directions.
'eb2a 2om fel sham3a elly gamaha' is gibberish.
'wa2a3 fw2 demaghi' is not an Egyptian idiom; calque.
Ending 'mish 3aref a2ol men el sabt' is nonsensical.
'akhally balaha' wrong collocation; Egyptian says 'akhod baly menha'.
Agreement error '7aga mesh mashi' (should be mashya).
'el khabar' is masculine so 'feeha' mismatches; '7ata 7eta' garbled.
'el nas elli feehom' and 'fel masriya' are unnatural/garbled.
'btoul eh 3alina', 'feehom akhbar el 3eyala' are broken Egyptian.
'el akla' is feminine singular; 'feehom' mismatches (should be feeha).
'ma fahemtsh 3aleh' wrong preposition; clause structure garbled.
'enta fehm' ungrammatical; Egyptian needs 'enta fahem'.
'bostaga' not a word; 'we fehm' lacks subject, unnatural.
'kol el nas fehm' agreement error; '7abto keda' awkward.
'akhot neshwa' odd; 'ba2ol enn el yom da gameel' stilted calque.
Agreement error 'kanet gameel' (should be gameela).
'mazal' is MSA/Levantine, not Egyptian; 'kalam el modir gamal' awkward.
'3ala ganoub el raf' (south of the shelf) is unnatural.
'tekhalles 3alaya' and 'asot el shay' are garbled.
'el match kan 3ala ganeb el telly' is nonsensical.
'ganeb el modeer' odd; 'a2ol el 7al eh' ungrammatical.
'ganeb el mahsheya' odd; 'lazi2' not a word.
'ra7a w gawda 3ala makani' is meaningless.
'ba3mel el 2ahwa 3ala gawda' is not Egyptian usage.
'gawda beta3ha kanet 3alya' odd word order, calques 'high quality'.
'gad za7ma', 'el shara3 3ala ba3adto' garbled.
Bare 'gad ta3ban' not Egyptian; would be 'begad ta3ban'.
'gad ba3d keda' misuses the word; unnatural.
'el mashwar beta3 el 3azouza' is unnatural and unclear.
'hat3alemny kol el akhbar' wrong verb; Egyptian says 'hat2olly'.
'el shara3 el gededa' gender mismatch; landmark 'teshof el 3arabeya' nonsensical.
'galy en' is wrong; should be '2aly' or '2alooly'.
'7atro7' (you) clashes with 'ashtery' (I); 'yebreh' garbled.
'janb ashaby' instead of 'ma3 as7aby'; 'tayeb' for food unnatural.
'el donya galbet 3ala janb khowaya' is gibberish.
'ba3mel khadamat el beit' calque; Egyptians say 'shoghl el beit'.
'nid3a' and 'ghada 3a2ely' are MSA/calques, not chat Egyptian.
'khadamat el sherka bet2akhkhar' unnatural collocation and agreement.
'el khadmet' article on construct form is ungrammatical; 'ya amala' odd.
'khadmet el la3eeba fiha' is meaningless.
'nerattib khadmet el beit el 3aila kolloha' garbled.
'kata' is not a word; sentence broken.
'gheir motawaqa2 zay da' MSA calque, unnatural in chat.
'el koshary el 3ala2' is garbled.
'awel khotwa men el matbakh lel tarabeza', 'gaan' nonsensical.
'betbansh 3alena wala khotwa' is not natural Egyptian.
'ma3a el khayr' opener not Egyptian; awkward overall.
'fel 3amal el gdid' MSA; sentence incoherent.
'at2akhkhara' is not a valid verb form.
'lel seel el gdeed' is garbled.
'la2' inserted unnaturally mid-sentence.
'el agaza el osbou3eya la2' incoherent; clauses run together.
'la2' misplaced; 'ma te3tezlesh 3alayya' ungrammatical.
'bas la2 el roz kan mal7 kteer 3alek' is garbled.
'3awarani' not a word; clause ungrammatical.
'2la law 3andak 3ard' after asking price is incoherent.
'ezayek' (fem.) clashes with 'ya 3am'; 'fi el ghayba' stilted.
'el zahma tayla' is not an Egyptian collocation.
'ba2et ana fel lwa2 el gedid' ungrammatical.
'Ya ma3alish' opener odd; 'mesh ha te3od tani' ungrammatical.
'el zar3a katir' is nonsensical as a reason.
'ne7ki 3al mawdo3' is Levantine, not Egyptian.
'nkerreb be3d tany' is garbled.
'kanet lazema afakkar' unnatural; Egyptian uses invariable 'kan lazem'.
'lazema artah' unnatural; Egyptian says 'lazem arta7'.
'lazema ashrab' unnatural; 'akhra3' garbled for akhrog.
